name: g66_kings_contact_drop
purpose: King's Shield (decision 0015 5cb, protect_kind 2): Aegislash (Stance Change) puts King's Shield up on turn 1 with no forme line (it is the Shield forme already). Garchomp's Dragon Claw (a contact move) is stopped with -activate move: Protect, and the attacker's Attack drops by one (-unboost, the holder as the source). Kingambit's Defiant is not on the attacker here, so no Defiant boost follows.
